gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-clash-grotesk: Clash Grotesk draws its letters in a smooth, hollow-tube line with no swelling at all, friendly and easy on the eye. And Bespoke Stencil, the commanding industrial heading, is the sharper half, which makes the plain sans feel gentle by comparison.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-fs-epilogue: Curvy, loose-limbed and wiry, Epilogue stands tall under the stencil-cut weight of Bespoke Stencil's industrial heading. Its stubby ascenders keep long text moving smoothly.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-fs-merriweather-s: Bespoke Stencil has a blunt, industrial command that stamps each heading like a crate marking. But Merriweather Sans stands taller in the lowercase, and its open e keeps a long read sturdy and easy to follow.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-fs-supreme: Supreme reads crisp and dense, a heavy band of text with letters held open. Bespoke Stencil is best at commanding, industrial headings, while Supreme does its finest work in the running text underneath, where the tall lowercase carries the words.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-general-sans: General Sans fills the line with tall, smooth letters. Bespoke Stencil does its best work announcing things in a blunt, industrial voice, whereas General Sans is made for the quieter job of carrying the words with a steady hand.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-gf-syncopate: Stencil-cut meets technical-pen precision here. Syncopate follows Bespoke Stencil's commanding heading with open, ruler-straight letters, and that steadiness is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-manrope: Bespoke Stencil's plain, cut-out letters give it a commanding industrial bite. Manrope sits below with bright open curves and a minimal step from capitals to lowercase, so give it a little more size than you think it needs.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-satoshi: Satoshi reads open and friendly, with a soaring x-height and an e that never squeezes shut. And if Bespoke Stencil were made small, its commanding industrial punch would fade, while the sans would hold up fine at larger sizes.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-switzer: Industrial punch up top, Swiss polish below. Bespoke Stencil is best at commanding attention in a heading, while Switzer, with its wire-like letterforms and tall waist line, is best at quietly carrying the text.
